text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Palmer ran through her debut race, 
but couldn't pull off the party-girl style 
she wanted.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
To run freely, one must first liberate 
their soul. The goal was set to gather 
9,000 fans who would vibe with Mejiro 
Palmer's party-animal lifestyle.
